title: Vanillafy
body: ![Vanillafy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e75e84320b5fb05f1f4bae283c6957227bf0c885.png) Don't play Vanilla. Play Vanillafy. Same game. Better everything. --- ## ✨ Overview Vanillafy is a carefully crafted Vanilla+ modpack for Minecraft 1.20.1. It enhances your game with better performance, cleaner UI, and subtle quality-of-life improvements without touching a single gameplay mechanic. It works on every server you already play on. This modpack focuses on: - Maximum FPS with minimum overhead - UI and HUD improvements that feel native - Immersive visual and audio polish - 100% server compatibility (client-side only) - Runs on low-end PCs from just 2 GB RAM --- ## 🚀 Features - ⚡ 2–4× FPS improvement over vanilla with Sodium + full stack - 🗺️ Minimap + world map - 🎒 Smarter inventory management with IPN - 🔊 Ambient sounds and realistic footsteps - 🧍 Smooth player animations (Not Enough Animations) - 📊 Better statistics, better F3, better options screen - 🎮 Works on Hypixel, Vanilla SMP, and every public server - 🪶 Extremely lightweight — 2 GB RAM minimum --- ## ⚡ Performance Vanillafy includes the most complete performance mod stack available for Fabric 1.20.1. Expect a dramatic FPS uplift on any hardware. Performance mods included: - Sodium — GPU rendering engine - Lithium — server-logic optimization - Starlight — lighting engine rewrite - FerriteCore — memory usage reduction - Krypton — network optimization - Noisium — world generation speedup - LazyDFU — startup time reduction - Dynamic FPS — frame management --- ## 🧩 Included Mods ### Performance - Sodium, Lithium, Starlight, FerriteCore - ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling, More Culling - ModernFix, Dynamic FPS, Krypton, Noisium - LazyDFU, FastQuit ### Quality of Life - Jade, AppleSkin, BetterF3 - Xaero's Minimap + World Map (Fair-play) - Inventory Profiles Next, Mouse Tweaks - ShulkerBoxTooltip, Reese's Sodium Options - Better Statistics Screen, Better Ping Display - Blur+, Enchantment Descriptions ### Visual & Immersion (Client-Only) - Ambient Sounds, Presence Footsteps - Not Enough Animations, Eating Animation - 3D Skin Layers, Chat Heads, Capes --- ## 💻 System Requirements Minimum: - 2 GB RAM allocated - Any CPU (dual-core+) - Integrated graphics supported Recommended: - 3–4 GB RAM allocated - Quad-core CPU - Any modern GPU --- ## 🌐 Multiplayer Vanillafy is 100% client-side. Every single mod works on any server without requiring server-side installation. Works on Hypixel, Vanilla SMPs, and every public Minecraft server. --- ## 🎯 Perfect For - Players coming from OptiFine looking for a modern replacement - Vanilla SMP players who want a better client - Low-end PC players needing max performance - Anyone who loves Minecraft but wants a smoother experience --- ## 📦 Version 1.0.0 Initial BETA release: - Complete performance stack - Full QoL suite - Immersive audio + animation layer - Server-safe, client-only --- ## 📝 Notes - Zero gameplay changes 100% vanilla-faithful - Safe for all servers including Hypixel - Lowest RAM requirement of any polished Vanilla+ pack - Update cadence: follows Sodium releases NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT!
